messages:
mia_cs: FYI — noticing a spike of 503s hitting the embeddings endpoint for a handful of private deployments (region eu-west-1). Pulling affected accounts now. Need comms + mitigation note for customers. @jake_sre can you confirm incident severity?

jake_sre: Confirmed intermittent 503s, error rate ~8% over the last 18m for private clusters running v1.12 runtime. Likely related to a recent KV cache eviction change rolled yesterday. Investigating.

olivia_support: Heads-up from support: two onboarding customers reported failures during vector uploads and their pipelines retried causing backpressure. Both are on Dedicated/Private.

sam_eng: Repro steps I ran: 
```
curl -X POST https://private-api.customer/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -v
# response: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable intermittently
```
Noted increased latency before 503. Stack traces show short OOM spikes inside embedding process.

jake_sre: Root cause hypothesis: cache eviction policy + spike in concurrent prefix requests causing memory pressure on embedding workers. Working on a rollback of the eviction config and a temp limit on concurrent embedding requests.

cecilia_account: Can we get a short status note I can send to affected accounts? They need: what happened, impact, ETA for fix, and temporary mitigations for customers.

mia_cs: Draft status for customers (short):
"Hello — we’re investigating intermittent 503 responses when calling the embeddings endpoint for private deployments in eu-west-1. Impact: some uploads and generation calls may fail or retry. Engineers are rolling back a recent cache-change and applying rate-limits to reduce errors. We’ll post an update within 60 minutes and a follow-up RCA. If you see ongoing failures, please reply here or open a support ticket and include request IDs. Apologies for the disruption."

ashley_pm: Suggest adding: recommended customer mitigation steps: 1) exponential backoff on retries (start 200ms, cap 5s), 2) reduce batch sizes temporarily, 3) if on autoscaling, increase worker min replicas.

olivia_support: I'll send that to the affected accounts now and include a workaround doc link. Will CC product and SRE.

incident-bot: [incident created] INC-2026-0453 assigned to eng-sre; priority P2; Pager duty: @jake_sre.

sam_eng: Quick mitigation plan: 
- revert cache eviction change (5m)
- temporarily cap concurrent embedding requests at 16 per node (2m)
- monitor error rate + latency for 30m
- if regressions persist, scale up embedding workers by +20% (10m)
I can run the revert now if SRE gives :thumbsup:.

jake_sre: Go for revert. I'll patch the rate-limit gate and start the rollout to eu-west-1.

mia_cs: Olivia/cecilia thanks. I'll hold a short customer sync at +30 to triage any escalation requests and track renewals at risk.

cecilia_account: Quick ask — can we get a list of affected accounts and their ARR so I can prioritize outreach?

sam_eng: Affected list (top-level): 
- acme-ai (onboarding, ARR: $48k)
- beta-fintech (trial, ARR: $0)
- clara-marketing (onboarding, ARR: $12k)
- delta-analytics (enterprise, ARR: $220k)
I'll DM full request IDs to Olivia secure channel.

olivia_support: Sent initial status to acme-ai and clara-marketing. Acme asked for ETA and whether retries could lead to duplicate embeddings — told them we recommend idempotent client dedupe and we'll include guidance.

ashley_pm: For the RCA draft: timeline + cause + mitigations + long-term fixes. Long-term items: better memory headroom detection, throttle-aware KV eviction, and pre-deploy canary for cache config.

mia_cs: Good. Action items: 
- Jake/Sam: execute revert + rate limit (in progress)
- Olivia: outbound status to all affected (done/in progress)
- Cecilia: prioritize high-ARR outreach after next update
- Ashley: start RCA doc skeleton (assign to product)
- Mia (me): compile customer-facing FAQ + template for renewals team
I'll update thread after next monitoring pass (target +35m).

jake_sre: Revert started at 1792501410, rate-limit gate applied at 1792501455. Early signals: error rate falling from 8% -> 2% in last 3m. Continuing to monitor.

olivia_support: Customer reply: acme-ai confirmed reduced failures after our workaround, appreciated the prompt reply.

mia_cs: Noted. ETA to broad resolution: 45m; will confirm RCA timeline later today. If any customer escalates to legal/compliance, tag me immediately.

sam_eng: Monitoring graphs: embedding worker memory usage down ~18% post-revert. Holding for 30m before closing incident.

cecilia_account: Thanks team — I'll follow up with delta-analytics personally (high ARR). Keep me posted if anything changes.

mia_cs: Update posted to customers at 1792501530 — brief note + link to temporary mitigation steps. Closing loop in 30m unless error rate rises. :white_check_mark:

jake_sre: Final note for thread: incident classified P2, cause: cache eviction change + concurrency spike -> memory pressure -> OOM/503s. Immediate mitigation: rollback + concurrency cap + reduced batch size recommendations. Long-term: throttle-aware eviction and canary config. RCA doc to follow.

mia_cs: Great work. I'll convert the thread notes into an email template for renewals and a short FAQ for onboarding docs.

olivia_support: Will attach logs and request IDs to the support tickets for each affected account.

mia_cs: Thread closed for now. Will reopen if error rate >3% or new escalations come in.
